title: A Study to Investigate Airway Inflammation With Dupilumab Subcutaneously in Participants Aged ≥40 to ≤85 Years With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
note: Simplified for the demo, not the full protocol. Key criteria only.

criteria.text: Smoking history of at least 10 pack-years
criteria.reason: Smoking status is recorded but not how much. Check the social history.

criteria.text: Moderate-to-severe COPD: post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC under 0.70, and FEV1 30–70% of predicted
criteria.notes: FEV1/FVC is stored as a percentage in this data. FEV1 % predicted isn't recorded, so a pass here still needs the full spirometry report at screening.

criteria.text: Frequent or severe exacerbations (GOLD group E)

question.instructions: Does this patient with COPD have frequent or severe COPD exacerbations in the last year: two or more flare-ups treated with oral steroids or antibiotics, or at least one hospital admission for COPD? Choose MATCH if the record shows that. Choose NO_MATCH if the record covers the last year and shows no COPD-related emergency visits, admissions or steroid courses. Choose UNKNOWN if there are emergency or urgent care visits with no reason recorded, or the record can't settle it.

criteria.text: Triple inhaler therapy (inhaled corticosteroid + LABA + LAMA) for 3 months, or LABA + LAMA if a steroid is contraindicated
criteria.reason: Synthea, which made the demo data, doesn't prescribe LAMA inhalers, so this can't be checked here. With real EHR data it's a medication-list check.

criteria.text: Blood eosinophils at least 300 cells/μL at screening, or at least 150 at screening with a past value of at least 300
criteria.reason: Measured at the screening visit; rarely in the record.

criteria.text: Current or past diagnosis of asthma
Significant lung disease other than COPD (lung fibrosis, sarcoidosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, bronchiectasis) or alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
